title: Publish roles in the session preamble and record what effort does not deliver
action: Slice 7, the last code. TWO JOBS. (1) The session preamble carries a Dispatch door block (decision 46827304 D2) that names the prepare command and the resolved tier slots so a cold agent sees, before its first dispatch, what is configured. It still says --kind cell|gather|reviewer|advisor and still lists TIER slots. Both are now stale: --role <name> exists (decision 8ff6e79e), the role set is open so there is no fixed list to print, and a name nothing configures refuses BY NAME with a FIX. Rewrite that block to publish the roles the host actually configures plus the --role spelling. Keep it SHORT — it is injected into every session and length is a real cost; publishing a long list of names would be worse than the tier list it replaces. (2) Record the effort non-delivery, which CONTEXT.md's open questions require and which no cell has yet discharged: effort parses on a {model, effort} entry and the preamble RENDERS it as model:effort, but the door drops it for every Resolved::Model (prepare.rs sites) and only the codex native branch emits reasoning_effort. So bee prints an effort it does not send on claude, AND drops it on the codex spawn_agent arm too — two different causes, and the earlier claim that this is purely a claude harness limit does not cover the codex half. Either stop rendering what is not sent, or render it with an honest qualifier; choose, and say which on the cap. Do NOT silently keep printing a value the dispatch discards — that is the same silent-lie shape this whole feature exists to remove. Run your verify with --no-fail-fast.

truths: The preamble's dispatch block names --role and the roles this host configures, not a fixed tier list
The block did not grow materially — it is injected into every session
The preamble no longer prints an effort the dispatch discards, or prints it with an honest qualifier; the cap states which and why
The codex spawn_agent drop is named, not folded into the claude harness explanation

trace.outcome: The dispatch door publishes the host's configured roles and --role instead of a fixed tier list, and stops printing an effort no dispatch carries
deviations: Effort resolution: STOP RENDERING it rather than qualify it. The block is injected into every session and re-injected after every compaction, so a qualifier is repeated length spent on a value nothing sends; the non-delivery is written down at the render site (render_role doc comment) and in decision fbbadad5 instead.

The codex drop is recorded as its OWN fact, not folded into the claude harness reason: on claude every Resolved::Model site in prepare.rs destructures { model, .. } and the Agent tool takes no effort parameter (harness limit); on codex the spawn_agent arm emits neither model nor reasoning_effort even though the runtime accepts it and the native arm does emit it (bee's own gap, still open).

Scope: two files beyond the cell, both reserved under mrs-w20 first. hooks/model_guard.rs holds tier_slot_display, the fixed-4-slot renderer that could not serve an open set — replaced by role_slot_display + dispatch_door_lines. hooks/compaction.rs carried a byte-copy of the same two lines and would otherwise have told a compacted session the list the preamble stopped saying; it now calls the one home.
hooks/session_preamble/store.rs was reserved but needed no change — its D6 escalation-share work already landed.
No regen needed: no skill, doc or generated artifact carries the old "Tier slots" text (rg over the tree, excluding target/). Regen stays with mrs-w21.
